_comment: EXAMPLE ONLY. These credit prices are placeholders for local testing, not approved ASZDA prices.
Copy this file (e.g. to pricing.json), set the numbers you decide on, and point ASZDA_PRICING_FILE at it.
credits_per_1000: ASZDA credits charged per 1000 units of each usage metric.
provider_usd_per_1000: OPTIONAL, what the provider charges you; only used for admin cost estimates.
Anthropic USD rates below are from Anthropic's published price table (Claude Opus 5.5: $4 / $20 per million input / output tokens) as of 2026-10-06; re-check before relying on them.
OpenAI and Runway provider USD rates are intentionally left out because they were not verified from official pricing pages. Add them when you have confirmed them.
Models missing from this file cannot be used at all.
